The '''University of Timb''' was located on [[V'shar]], dedicated to the study of ancient civilizations. <ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

[[Kaltor Naklian]] was a teacher of Ka'hren history at this University before discovering old writings and creating [[Ni'Shaw-Dak Ministry|Ni'Shaw-Dak]] sect.<ref name="AIR" />
